c987aed75b01f9ef.title: 37% of pre-SIR Form-6 applications rejected due to absence of declaration form
c987aed75b01f9ef.summary: Updated - November 02, 2026 04:35 pm IST - HYDERABAD A large number of applications for fresh voter registration, submitted through Form-6 before the start of Special Intensive Revision, got rejected because they were not accompanied by a declaration form mandated as a prerequisite for enrolment. The image is used for representative purposes only. Shifting goal posts by the Election Commission of India (ECI) with regard to the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the Electoral Rolls have resulted in rejection of tens of thousands of application forms for new voter enrolments in Telangana. A large number of applications for fresh voter registration, submitted through Form-6 before the start of the SIR process, got rejected because they were not accompanied by a declaration form mandated as a prerequisite for enrolment. The declaration form, which was an attachment to the Form-6 exclusively for the SIR process, sought details of the voter or the voter’s parents/relatives from 2002 SIR. In the absence of such details, the applicants were required to submit any of the listed 12 documents as proof of their citizenship. The ECI recently announced that the declaration was not required for submission of Form-6 in States where SIR is not on . It was too late for Telangana, where a large number of voters who had submitted Form-6 before the start of SIR were rejected for lack of the declaration form. As per data obtained from the office of the Telangana Chief Electoral Officer, a total of 5,20,331 applications were received for new enrolments during the pre-SIR period between January 1, 2026 and June 14, 2026. They were not accompanied by the declaration form which was made mandatory only during the SIR process. As per the Registration of Electors Rules, 196, such claims should be exhibited at the office of the Electoral Registration Officer, and disposed of in a week’s time. They were brought safely to shore after their boat’s engine broke down at sea. Fishermen had been advised not to venture into the sea in view of Cyclone Murasu. Speaking to the media, District Collector Himanshu Shukla said, “Seven fishermen who had set out for a fishing trip from Juvvaladinne Fishing Harbour noticed changes in the sea conditions while off the coast of Nellore and attempted to return to the harbour. However, their boat’s engine broke down en route, leaving them stranded at sea. Surveillance personnel on duty at the harbour spotted this and immediately alerted the relevant authorities.” Officials and local fishermen pull a boat ashore at Patakadapalem in SPSR Nellore district on Monday after its engine failed in seas made rough by Cyclone Murasu. All seven fishermen on board were rescued. 494bf2da99576b8e.title: Cyclone Murasu: CM directs officials to brace for flood into Bapatla district
494bf2da99576b8e.summary: Updated - November 02, 2026 04:47 pm IST - BAPATLA Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu reviews preparations for Cyclone Murasu with district officials through a video conference on Monday. Bapatla district is likely to bear the brunt of the storm. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to take all precautionary measures to prevent loss of life and property in Bapatla district in view of Cyclone Murasu , which has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm. He reviewed the preparedness of district administrations through a video conference on Monday (November 2, 2026), attended by Bapatla Collector Vinod Kumar V. The Chief Minister warned that Bapatla was likely to bear the brunt of the cyclone, since heavy inflows of floodwater were expected through irrigation canals from upstream districts, including Guntur, Palnadu, Prakasam and Markapuram. He asked officials to inspect canal bunds, remain alert for four days of heavy inflows, evacuate people from low-lying areas and establish rehabilitation centres. He also said a special officer would be appointed for Bapatla district. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to take all precautionary measures to prevent loss of life and property in Bapatla district in view of Cyclone Murasu , which has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm. 08c48fb1267ea4bf.title: New logo, new inaugural venue: Stage set for iconic Kolkata International Film Festival
08c48fb1267ea4bf.summary: Updated - November 02, 2026 03:00 pm IST - Kolkata New logo of 32nd Kolkata Internation Film Festival was designed by Satyajit Ray’s son filmmaker Sandip Ray, and was unveiled on November 1, 2026. With a new logo in black and saffron and a new venue at Victoria Memorial for the inaugural ceremony, the 32 nd Kolkata International Film Festival (KIFF) is all set to lay the carpet for cine-lovers from across the world from December 16 to December 23 this year. The new logo, which was unveiled on Sunday (November 1, 2026) at Nandan by the festival authority, was redesigned by the son of Satyajit Ray, filmmaker Sandip Ray. The latest logo replaces the previous blue-and-white artwork, which was launched in 2015. The first KIFF under the new Bharatiya Janata Party government in West Bengal is witnessing a complete overhaul, with superstar Tollywood Prosenjit Chatterjee as the KIFF chairperson and veteran actor Mithun Chakraborty as the Chief Advisor. Some other prominent faces of the Bengal film industry, including actor Jeet, Hiran Chatterjee, actor-cum-politician Rudranil Ghosh, and Nandan CEO and KIFF Director Sharmistha Banerjee, were also present at Sunday’s (November 1) event. Addressing the event, Mr. Chatterjee said that the inaugural ceremony of the festival will also take place at Victoria Memorial for the first time. The venues that have earlier been used by the previous Trinamool Congress government since 2011 include Netaji Indoor Stadium and Dhono Dhanyo Auditorium while the festival was also organised at Nandan during the COVID-19 pandemic. Nandan was also the traditional venue for the festival in its initial years. According to the officials, superstars Rajinikanth, Akshay Kumar, and Prabhas may make their maiden appearances at KIFF this year, along with a star-studded lineup from the film industries across the country. The guest list for the inaugural ceremony of the festival may also include Sanjay Dutt, Paresh Rawal, Anupam Kher, Johnny Lever, Kangana Ra

911b88855c3e65da.title: Rain begins in north Andhra ahead of Cyclone Murasu
911b88855c3e65da.summary: Updated - November 02, 2026 02:06 pm IST - VIJAYAWADA Rough waves lash the Palepalem coast near Kothapatnam in Prakasam district on Monday, ahead of Cyclone Murasu’s expected landfall near Ongole. | Photo Credit: Kommuri Srinivas The first rain from Cyclone Murasu has fallen in north coastal Andhra Pradesh, far from where the storm is headed. The central and south coastal districts, which are on red alert, were yet to see any major rainfall on Monday (November 2, 2026). Kakinada (Rural) mandal recorded the most rain between 8.30 a.m. and noon, 51.75 mm at the MRO office gauge, according to real-time data from the Andhra Pradesh Directorate of Economics and Statistics (APDES). Most of the rain fell in Kakinada, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam districts. Visakhapatnam’s highest reading was 12.5 mm at Gambheeram in Anandapuram mandal. Ongole in Prakasam district, where the landfall is likely to happen, had not recorded any rain as of 10 a.m. The Rayalaseema districts stayed dry. In the 24 hours to 8.30 a.m. on Monday, Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram district recorded the most rain in the State, 102.49 mm at the KVBR School gauge. Meanwhile, the severe cyclonic storm over the west-central and southwest Bay of Bengal is moving west-northwestwards at 22 kmph towards the A.P. coast. At 8.30 a.m. on Monday, the storm was located about 160 km east-southeast of Nellore, 180 km northeast of Chennai, 180 km east-southeast of Kavali, 210 km southeast of Ongole and 240 km south of Machilipatnam. Weather experts said the system had moved fast in the morning but may slow down near the coast. The landfall is likely between 11.30 p.m. on Monday and 4 a.m. on Tuesday, according to the India Meteorological Department. 06beca9cee78fcfc.title: ‘Cyclone Murasu’: Palnadu District Collector declares November 2 holiday for schools, colleges
06beca9cee78fcfc.summary: Updated - November 02, 2026 03:00 pm IST - NARASARAOPET (PALNADU DISTRICT) Palnadu District Collector Kritika Shukla. Photo: Special Arranagement Palnadu District Collector Kritika Shukla has announced holiday for all government and private schools, colleges and Anganwadi centres on Tuesday (November 2) in view of Cyclone Murasu. The Collector, in a press release here on Sunday, informed that the district administration has made all necessary arrangements to effectively deal with Cyclone Murasu. Cyclone Murasu LIVE updates: November 02, 2026 A special control room has been set up at the Collectorate to ensure that people do not face any inconvenience due to the cyclone and to facilitate immediate relief measures. The control room will function round-the-clock. Staff have been deployed to provide necessary information to the public and coordinate relief operations. People can contact the control room for emergency assistance or information on the number 08647 252999 In view of the cyclone warnings, the District Collector urged people to remain alert and avoid going outdoors unless absolutely necessary. 881e0e5508b663df.title: Watch: Delhi chokes again as AQI hits 310, restrictions tighten
881e0e5508b663df.summary: Delhi’s air quality deteriorated to the ‘very poor’ category on November 2, with the AQI touching 310. As pollution levels rise across north India, the Delhi government has introduced winter restrictions, including curbs on older vehicles, construction activities and private offices. Here’s what the measures mean and why Delhi continues to battle severe air pollution every winter.
